throughPassages.evidence: BAG 0363100012091838 ring: the 8.7 x 2.9 m strip between the Fedlev wing (east face u -5.52) and the tower (west face u 3.21) is the plan of the footbridge, which starts at the wing's screen-storey floor (5.35 m); under it the paved path between Fred. Roeskestraat and the courtyard runs through at ground level (Commons Fedlev-vleugel (3), Ceescamel 2019: the path and bollards under the bridge; PDOK orthophoto).

Commons Fedlev-vleugel (5) and (6) (Ceescamel 2019): the landing stands on its V-shaped pylon 4.5 m out from the north front with the open, paved space under it reaching back to the ground-floor glass 1.5 m behind the screen line; nothing closes it at ground level.
